# Let's fetch all habit log notes and extract the ate_homemade_meals value for each date.
note_ids = list(range(1971, 1991))  # 1971 to 1990 inclusive
habit_data = []
for nid in note_ids:
    note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=nid, access_token=access_token)
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Log -- YYYY-MM-DD"
    date_str = note['title'].split('-- ')[1].strip()
    # Parse content lines to find ate_homemade_meals
    content_lines = note['content'].split('\n')
    ate_value = None
    for line in content_lines:
        if line.startswith('ate_homemade_meals:'):
            ate_value = line.split(':')[1].strip()
            break
    habit_data.append((date_str, ate_value))
    print(f"{date_str}: {ate_value}")
